subject: Palm Press Inc. Studio Profile
overview: Host John Petrella interviewed Gus Gaiffus and Ross Kaya about their fine art photography studio and bookstore, Palm Press Inc., located in Medford Square. The discussion highlighted the studio's history of museum-grade printing and the various services it offers to the Medford community.

items.title: Professional Backgrounds of Guests
items.summary: Gus Gaiffus and Ross Kaya shared their professional histories in photography, art education, and music.

items.title: Relocation to Medford Square
items.summary: The guests described moving the studio from Chelsea to a former bank building in Medford and building a custom darkroom.

items.title: Photographic and Framing Services
items.summary: Palm Press Inc. provides museum-quality silver printing, digital inkjet imaging, and custom framing for artwork and memorabilia.

items.title: Photo Bookstore and Artist Events
items.summary: The studio features a curated photo book collection and hosts regular Thursday night artist talks and book signings.

items.title: Darkroom Instruction and Rental Programs
items.summary: The business offers one-on-one darkroom lessons and daily equipment rentals for vetted photographers.
